speaker: Theresis
content: A clothesmaker, and a guard.

speaker: Theresa
content: Did you hear that, Theresis?

raw: [name="Theresa"]The myriad souls speak from under our feet...
speaker: Theresa
content: The myriad souls speak from under our feet...

speaker: Theresa
content: Ah.

speaker: Theresa
content: There it is.

speaker: Theresis
content: Yes.

speaker: Theresis
content: To think it was this small.
The crown.
With death as a witness—

raw: As well as the myriad souls—
content: As well as the myriad souls—

raw: The twins raise the crown in unison.
content: The twins raise the crown in unison.

raw: The crown chooses the twins in return.
content: The crown chooses the twins in return.

raw: Atop the ruins, the myriad souls, whose existence remains uncertain, select two distinct hopes at a time.
content: Atop the ruins, the myriad souls, whose existence remains uncertain, select two distinct hopes at a time.

speaker: Theresis
content: ...You should wear the crown, Theresa.

speaker: Theresa
content: Why?

raw: [name="Theresis"]The King of Sarkaz is but an optimistic fantasy for the pitiful when history chooses to stay silent.
speaker: Theresis
content: The King of Sarkaz is but an optimistic fantasy for the pitiful when history chooses to stay silent.

raw: [name="Theresa"]Indeed... we will change the Sarkaz's fate, with or without relying on an external force.
speaker: Theresa
content: Indeed... we will change the Sarkaz's fate, with or without relying on an external force.

raw: [name="Theresa"]But in this age of despair, it will bring a glimmer of hope to our people.
speaker: Theresa
content: But in this age of despair, it will bring a glimmer of hope to our people.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I'm not fit to be that hope bringer.
speaker: Theresis
content: I'm not fit to be that hope bringer.

raw: [name="Theresis"]My blade will cut our path forward. And you will lead the way.
speaker: Theresis
content: My blade will cut our path forward. And you will lead the way.

speaker: Theresa
content: ...I understand.

raw: [name="Theresis"]The war has just ended. How long will we bear this crown?
speaker: Theresis
content: The war has just ended. How long will we bear this crown?

raw: [name="Theresa"]Until we find a home again. Until the Black Crown swallows us into its suffering...
speaker: Theresa
content: Until we find a home again. Until the Black Crown swallows us into its suffering...

raw: [name="Theresa"]Until everyone under the same sky can fall into a peaceful slumber.
speaker: Theresa
content: Until everyone under the same sky can fall into a peaceful slumber.

raw: [name="Theresa"]'Lead the way forward', you said. Do you still remember that adventure of ours?
speaker: Theresa
content: 'Lead the way forward', you said. Do you still remember that adventure of ours?

raw: [name="Theresa"]You held your sword and carried me...
speaker: Theresa
content: You held your sword and carried me...

raw: [name="Theresis"]And you guided me through the bushes until we got home.
speaker: Theresis
content: And you guided me through the bushes until we got home.

speaker: Theresis
content: Theresa...

speaker: Theresis
content: Allow me to crown you myself.

speaker: Theresa
content: Alright.

speaker: Theresa
content: Theresis...

raw: [name="Theresa"]I swear this vow to every Sarkaz...
speaker: Theresa
content: I swear this vow to every Sarkaz...

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", text="'We will always be equal.'",delay=0.001, width=800, x=275, y=330, duration=3, alignment="center", size=24)]
